Description: Automatically create incident records when alerts are received from security monitoring tools or SIEM systems. This automation ensures immediate documentation of potential security events [\[1\]](https://www.resolver.com/corporate-security-software/incident-management/#:~:text=Resolver%27s%20top%2Drated%20security%20incident,%26%20improve%20reporting%20by).

Automatically assign priority levels to incidents based on predefined criteria such as impact, urgency, and affected systems. This helps in quick triage and response allocation [\[2\]](https://www.resolver.com/#:~:text=Resolver%27s%20Risk%20Intelligence%20platform,business%20impact%20within%20every).
Automatically route incidents to appropriate response teams based on incident type, severity, or affected systems. This ensures rapid response from the right team members.
Send automated notifications to relevant stakeholders when new incidents are created or when critical updates occur. This keeps all parties informed of incident status and progress.
Automatically create initial response actions based on incident type and severity, including creating checklists and assigning initial tasks to responders.
Automatically identify and link related incidents based on common attributes, affected systems, or timing. This helps in identifying patterns and potential widespread issues.
Automatically escalate incidents that meet critical criteria or remain unresolved beyond SLA timeframes. This ensures high-priority incidents receive appropriate attention.

Automatically calculate and update risk scores based on incident details, impact assessments, and historical data [\[2\]](https://www.resolver.com/#:~:text=Resolver%27s%20Risk%20Intelligence%20platform,business%20impact%20within%20every).
Automatically generate incident reports and dashboards for different stakeholder groups based on predefined templates and schedules.
Automatically archive resolved incidents after a specified period, maintaining proper documentation while keeping active incidents visible.
Automatically create investigation tasks based on incident type and severity, including evidence collection and analysis steps.
Automatically populate affected asset information from CMDB or asset management systems when incidents are created.
Automatically monitor and track SLA compliance for incident response times and send alerts when breaches are imminent.
Automatically calculate and update incident management metrics such as mean time to resolve (MTTR) and response effectiveness.
Automatically create post-incident review tasks and documentation requirements for resolved incidents that meet specific criteria.
Automatically update incident status based on task completion and response actions taken. This maintains accurate progress tracking.
Automatically categorize incidents based on incident details, affected systems, and pattern matching with historical data.

Automatically analyze incident trends and patterns to identify recurring issues or emerging threats [\[3\]](https://www.atlassian.com/incident-management/tools#:~:text=Explore%20the%20key%20features,incident%20response%20and%20seamless).
Automatically link relevant knowledge base articles and resolution guides based on incident categorization.
Automatically log all communications and updates related to an incident for audit and review purposes.
Automatically schedule incident review meetings based on incident severity and organizational policies.
Automatically create lessons learned documentation based on incident resolution data and post-incident reviews.
Automatically update affected asset status in CMDB or asset management systems based on incident impact.
Automatically generate recovery tasks based on incident type and affected systems.
Automatically track and calculate incident-related costs based on response efforts and business impact.
